description: Meta tools for tool discovery and inspection - helps AI find and understand available tools

tools.name: list_platform_tools
tools.description: List all tools available for a specific platform. Use this to discover what tools exist for platforms like quote_calculator, xero, shopify, inhouse_print, google_workspace, microsoft_365, etc.

returns.description: List of tool names with short descriptions for the specified platform

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search for tools by keyword or description across all platforms. Use this when you know what you want to do but don't know which tool to use.

returns.description: List of matching tools with relevance scores and descriptions

tools.name: get_tool_schema
tools.description: Get detailed parameter schema for a specific tool including parameter types, descriptions, required fields, and examples. Use this before calling a tool to understand what parameters it needs.

returns.description: Complete tool schema including name, description, parameters with types/enums/examples, and return value description

tools.name: list_available_platforms
tools.description: List all available platforms/modules in the system. Use this first if you don't know what platforms exist.

returns.description: List of platform names with tool counts and descriptions
